input.question: When was the Security Building constructed?

documents.text: The Security Improvement Company when the building was erected in 1905. In the 1950s, the famous penthouse was added, where Phoenix mover and shaker Walter Bimson, president of Valley Bank, once lived. The Security Building was added to the National Register of Historic Places in September 1985. Grace Lutheran Church (1928) 1124 N.
